result:
I would remove the human capacity to dehumanize others.

So much of the world’s cruelty becomes possible only after people are mentally reduced to categories: enemies, strangers, burdens, statistics, “those people.” If that switch stopped working—if other people’s humanity remained vivid and unavoidable—most large-scale violence, exploitation, and indifference would lose their engine.
